reset.title: Reset {{name}}?
reset.body: {{name}}'s profile is emptied, signing it out of every account it is signed in to on this host, and it starts again at its sign-in page. The accounts themselves are untouched.

toasts.startedOver: {{name}} is back at its sign-in page.
toasts.reset: {{name}} is starting again with an empty profile.

session.starting: Starting the browser. The first one can take a minute.
session.failed: The browser failed to start. Start over, or reset it.
session.startOverHint: Back to the sign-in page, staying signed in.

stream.label: The browser's screen
stream.disconnected: Lost the connection to the browser.
stream.unreachable: The browser is running, but its picture can't reach you.
stream.unreachableHelp: The host must accept the browser media ports, 59000 to 59007, over both UDP and TCP, from your network. Whoever runs Elysium can open them.
